Company Background: Kelvin Jute Ltd., was founded in 1907 and has a legacy of more than 100 years in manufacturing jute products. It is one of the 4 (four) jute mills owned by the Kankaria Group, a business conglomerate based in Kolkata, India having interest in Jute, Linen, Real Estate, Software Development, Renewable energy including others. The Group has more than 10% of the entire jute manufacturing capacity in India. At Kelvin Jute Mill, 2800 employees work diligently to make final products as per the requirement and satisfaction of the customer. Our current spinning production capacity is 110 metric tons per day. Diverse qualities of jute yarns, fabrics and gunny bags are manufactured in-house. We stitch more than 200,000 jute gunny bags every day. Our Food Grade Jute Fabric and bags are manufactured as per IJO 98/01 standards and are MOSH & MOAH compliant. To eliminate any contamination, we only use Vegetable Oil at our entire Hessian and DW Sacking Bag manufacturing unit. We are currently supplying Food Grade bags to India, Indonesia and some Latin American countries.

Company Background: Xipeng Zhai was founded by Mr. Zhang Qi in Huaxian, Shaanxi in 1980. The sound of "xi peng" is the same as the "xi peng" in shadow puppetry. In ancient times, shadow puppetry studios were often surrounded by bamboo mats, and shadow puppetry performers performed inside the mats, hence taking inspiration from the popular scene of "bamboo mats in a shed". There are also people who use bamboo as inspiration and use the metaphor of a simple and pragmatic life ambition, hence the name 'Xi Peng Zhai'. Xi Peng Zhai is committed to promoting shadow puppetry art and developing cultural and creative products. Since its establishment, it has adhered to the rigorous attitude of "striving for excellence and reaching the masses", and is committed to bringing traditional intangible cultural heritage into daily life. In Xi Peng Zhai, intangible cultural heritage can be better lived.
